P1: 16号道路 links 玉虹市 to 17号道路. The road southward to 浅红市 can be dangerous for pedestrians, so be sure to bring a Bicycle.
P2: There is a house located deep in the trees on the north side of the path, blocked by a 居合斩. Speak to the elderly man inside every day to learn a new trendy phrase to be used in the easy chat system.
P3: The bridges of 17号道路 pass over the ocean on the way downhill to 18号道路. Anyone riding a Bicycle on Cycling Road who decides to stop pedaling will continue rolling southward.
D1: West side, between the second and third pair of streetlights from the north (hidden)
D2: West side, between the fifth and sixth pair of streetlights from the north (hidden)
D3: Sometimes given out by Biker Reese, after registering his phone number
D4: Sometimes given out by Biker Aiden, after registering his phone number
P4: 18号道路 leads east from 17号道路 to 浅红市.
P5: 浅红市 is the largest city in southern Kanto, located between 18号道路 and 15号道路. To the south, a beach leads to the waters of 19号道路. Trainers aiming to earn their next Badge can challenge the Fuchsia Gym in the southwest. Pal Park stands in the northern part of the city.
D5: North of the Poké Mart, on a tree (daily; requires 居合斩)
D6: Northeast area, east of the single flower display (hidden)
D7: From Gym Leader Janine, after defeating her
P6: The southeastern house belongs to Baoba, the Safari Zone warden. According to his granddaughter, after he closed the Kanto and moved it to Johto, his son used the empty lot to establish Pal Park in its place. It seems that catching and releasing Pokémon runs in the family!
P7: A Juggler can be found standing in the northeast part of the city, on the path to Pal Park. Like the Juggler in 桔梗市, he gives out three different types of Berry in exchange for a Shard. The type of Berry received depends on the Shard's color.
P8: Pal Park is a special Pokémon preserve located in the northern part of 浅红市. The park gives Trainers a place to gather Pokémon from other adventures by migrating them from other regions.
P9: Migration is a permanent, one-way method of transport. Exactly 6 Pokémon are transferred to Pal Park at a time. In order to obtain the migrated Pokémon, Trainers must catch all six in an event called the Catching Show.
P10: When the Catching Show begins, Trainers are given six 公园球s, a special type of Poké Ball that never fails. The park is divided into five different environments, with each Pokémon found in the one that best represents its natural habitat. When a Pokémon is encountered, there are only two commands: Throw Ball and Run. Even after running from a Pokémon, it can still be encountered again until it is caught. After catching all six Pokémon, Trainers are given the chance to transfer them into their PC.
P11: Baoba's son stands at the front desk. He recognizes you immediately has the hotshot Trainer that he was told about by his father. He always gives the player a Berry as a reward after a completed show; the higher the score, the rarer the Berry.
C4:
Fuchsia City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Janine
The Poisonous Ninja Master
P12: The Fuchsia Gym specializes in 毒 Pokémon. Poison-type moves are super effective against 草 Pokémon, while Poison-type Pokémon are weak to 地面- and 超能力 moves.
P13: The Gym Leader is trained in the skills of the ninja, and has installed a series of nearly invisible glass panels to disorient any challengers. In addition, each of the Gym Trainers has disguised themselves as the Gym Leader. Follow the east wall toward the back of the building, then loop around toward the front. The Gym Leader is located near the center of the building.
P14: Janine's Pokémon use poisoning and 混乱 to incapacitate their opponent. Her 叉字蝠 is fast, so hit it with 超能力-, 电-, 冰-, or 岩石 attacks to take it down quickly. Her 双弹瓦斯 is dangerous, as 剧毒 badly poisons the target, and 大爆炸 is a last-ditch move that deals massive damage. Its phsycial 防御 is high, so use Psychic-type moves to target its lower 特防 instead. Her two 阿利多斯 can confuse the target with 虚张声势 and lower the target's Speed with 鬼面. Her 摩鲁蛾 prefers to use poison- and confusion-inducing moves. As 虫 Pokémon, both it and her two Ariados take serious damage from 火-, Rock-, and 飞行 attacks.
P15: After the battle, Janine awards you the 粉红徽章. She also hands out 招式学习器84（毒击） as a prize.
P16: The ocean route leading southward is blocked by rocky debris. According to the guard in the gate, these boulders landed here as a result of 红莲岛's volcano erupting. The only other way out of 浅红市 is east to 15号道路.
